The butterfly has its wings spread open (dorsal view), revealing a uniform dark brown coloration with distinct rows of small, circular eyespots (ocelli) on both the forewings and hindwings. The body is slender, hairy, and brown, positioned centrally between the wings. The antennae are visible at the head, appearing clubbed. The background consists of out-of-focus dry vegetation.
